instruction: Stage every file in the current project using the git add command in the terminal.

command: git config --global user.name "xlang" && git config --global user.email "xlang2024anonym@gmail.com" && mkdir -p /home/user/projects/remote_project && cd /home/user/projects/remote_project && git init --initial-branch=main && git config receive.denyCurrentBranch ignore
unzip -q /home/user/Downloads/binder.zip -d /home/user/projects/ && cd /home/user/projects/binder && git init --initial-branch main && git remote add origin /home/user/projects/remote_project

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to stage all files using git add. Evaluator checks git status output shows 'Changes to be committed' and excludes 'Untracked files', indicating files are properly staged. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric and vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly executes 'git status' in the target directory (/home/user/projects/binder) to extract staging state
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies that 'Changes to be committed' is present and 'Untracked files' is absent, which accurately indicates all files are staged
Expected values are semantically correct: 'Changes to be committed' appears when files are staged, 'Untracked files' appears only when unstaged files exist
Complete coverage: verifies both that files ARE staged (include check) and that NO files remain unstaged (exclude check)
No edge case issues: evaluator works correctly regardless of initial repository state, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: vm_command_line extracts git status output -> check_include_exclude verifies presence/absence of expected strings -> returns 1.0 only when all files are staged
